_readme: Soundtrack flags for the Argus chapter list (kept separate because chapters.json is auto-generated and gets overwritten). Key = the chapter's WebNovel ID: the number after the last underscore in the chapter's link (e.g. .../9th-bullet_95499079936699183 -> 95499079936699183). To add music: set "soundtrack": true and put the YouTube link in "url". "title" is just a label for you and is ignored by the site. Chapters not listed here count as false.
